source: pareido.jp ROM-derived event table for Kyuuyaku Megami Tensei (SNES)
name: Mikon City
notes: Safe town: no random battles on 8F.
Coordinates are the Atlas (ROM) coordinates from the event table.
The local WRAM coordinates 0x877/0x878 are not identical to every event coordinate; event cells can be object cells on a wall.
Observed in-game (2026-11-17): the Gate Keeper is the blue demon at WRAM (2,2), triggered entering from (2,1) moving south; dialog text starts with 'おい、坊主！'.
Observed in-game: the down stairs are used from WRAM (2,3), the room immediately south of the Gate Keeper; the prompt is '階段を降りますか？' and YES descends to 7F WRAM (10,2).
The green old man at WRAM (3,3) says 'みな元気じゃな', pushes the player back to (3,2), and is not the Gate Keeper or the stairs.

events.label: 500 Macca + jewel
events.observed: Opened from local (0,5); 500 Macca and 宝玉 were received.

events.label: Gate Keeper (blue demon)
events.observed: Confirmed in-game at WRAM (2,2), entering from (2,1) moving south. Dialog: 'おい、坊主！ここから先は魔物の棲み家だぜ！行くことは言わないが気をつけてな'.

events.label: down stairs to 7F
events.observed: Used from WRAM (2,3), the room south of the Gate Keeper. Prompt: '階段を降りますか？' -> YES. 7F arrival: HUD '7F', WRAM (10,2), facing north.

events.label: central-block talk (not Gate Keeper)
events.observed: Explored at WRAM (3,3)/(4,3); no Gate Keeper dialog. The green old man at WRAM (3,3) says 'みな元気じゃな'.
